title: Three-Panel Majority Merge
written_solution: The two full-height divider columns split the input into three equal panels. For each cell position, check how many of the three panels contain a nonzero cell there. If at least two panels agree that the cell is occupied, place cyan(8) in the output; otherwise leave it black(0).

(lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range (rows g)))) (range (cols g)))) (d1 (first divs)) (d2 (second divs)) (p1 (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- d1 1))) (p2 (subgrid g 0 (+ d1 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- d2 1))) (p3 (subgrid g 0 (+ d2 1) (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))) (grid-from-fn (rows p1) (cols p1) (lambda (r c) (if (>= (+ (if (= (at p1 r c) 0) 0 1) (if (= (at p2 r c) 0) 0 1) (if (= (at p3 r c) 0) 0 1)) 2) 8 0))))))
